row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: ICE's developer guide says the Encompass SCIM APIs are compliant with SCIM 2.0 and that Encompass on the Web and Encompass Desktop support user provisioning via the ICE Mortgage Technology SCIM Interface; Encompass itself has no public pricing (Contact us).
row.notes: Quote-only: Encompass (ICE Mortgage Technology loan origination system) publishes no plans or prices, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. SCIM 2.0 lives at https://api.elliemae.com/scim2/v1 with an OAuth 2.0 bearer token from a Super Admin or Administrator persona. DELETE is a soft delete (disable); hard delete is not supported over SCIM; users can be re-enabled with PATCH. Groups are read-only except for member add/remove; group creation is not supported. Users use ICE's own extension schema (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ice:2.0:EncompassInternalUser) rather than the enterprise extension, and calls require a schema parameter, so a generic IdP connector may need customising. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery SCIM app was found; the Entra gallery 'Encompass' app is a different product (Vox Mobile). A separate non-SCIM V3 Internal Users REST API (Encompass 24.2+) supports create, update, disable and hard delete, and webhooks fire on internal-user create/update/delete.

scim.notes: UAT server: https://concept.api.elliemae.com. SCIM also provisions ICE DDA (AIQ) users and links them by a SCIM globalUserId. Users can be created as SSO or non-SSO users, so SSO is not a prerequisite.

auth.token_source: Encompass Platform OAuth 2.0 token endpoint (API key from the Encompass super administrator); caller must hold a Super Admin or Administrator persona

deprovision.data_retained: DELETE disables the user profile; the user record stays in the database and can be re-enabled via PATCH.

filtering.notes: The guide's Get Users sample passes filter=enc_isRecursive eq true, but filtering is not otherwise documented.

custom.how: ICE extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ice:2.0:EncompassInternalUser carries all user attributes, including: jobTitle, employeeId, apiUser, chumId, nmlsOriginatorId, nmlsExpirationDate, requirePasswordChange, isSsoOnly, ssoDisconnectedFromOrg, allowImpersonation, licenses, compensationPlans, oAuthClientId, subordinateLoanAccess, peerLoanAccess, loginEnabled, accountEnabled, comments, workingFolder, personas, ccSite, emailSignature, organization

roles.how: personas attribute (Encompass persona entityId); persona IDs come from GET encompass/v3/settings/personas

limitations.text: Hard delete is not supported over SCIM (DELETE only disables).
Group set-up and maintenance beyond member add/remove must be done in Encompass Admin.
Adding and managing standalone DDA users is not supported.
Only Super Admin or Administrator personas can call SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: List groups a user belongs to

audit_log_api.notes: SCIM calls update the Encompass system audit trail; no audit-log API was checked.

okta.notes: ICE publishes an Okta SSO setup guide; no OIN app found at okta.com/integrations/encompass/ (404).

entra.notes: ICE publishes a Microsoft Azure SSO setup guide. The Entra gallery 'Encompass' tutorial uses a voxmobile.com reply URL, i.e. a different product.

open_questions: Encompass pricing and whether SCIM or the API needs a specific licence are not public.
Docs do not say whether disabling a user frees a licence or ends active sessions.
ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas and ResourceTypes endpoints and SCIM filtering are not documented.
Rate limits for SCIM and V3 user APIs were not found.
No Okta, Entra, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud catalogue app for Encompass SCIM was found; whether IdPs provision it via their generic SCIM app is inferred from the generic endpoint only.
